title: The Storm Tested Our Plan
titleZh: 暴風雨考驗了我們的計畫
summaryZh: 年度最強暴風雨即將來襲，有人主張把共享傘鎖起來；Maya 和鄰居必須在保護物資與維持開放之間，找出真正能照顧社區的方法。

sentences.text: On Monday evening, the weather service warned that the strongest summer storm of the year would arrive before morning, bringing heavy rain and dangerous winds.
sentences.zh: 星期一晚上，氣象單位警告今年最強的夏季暴風雨將在早晨前抵達，並帶來豪雨和危險強風。

sentences.text: Maya checked the three return points and counted eighteen blue umbrellas across the neighborhood before locking the cafe for the night.
sentences.zh: Maya 在咖啡店夜間上鎖前，檢查了三個歸還點，清點出社區裡共有十八把藍傘。

sentences.text: That number sounded large, but hundreds of people used the bus station and library each day, especially during the busy morning hours.
sentences.zh: 這個數字聽起來很多，但每天有數百人使用公車站和圖書館，尤其是在繁忙的早晨時段。

sentences.text: Several neighbors gathered under the cafe's yellow lights and discussed how to protect the umbrellas during the coming storm.
sentences.zh: 幾位鄰居聚集在咖啡店的黃色燈光下，討論該如何在即將到來的風暴中保護雨傘。

sentences.text: One man suggested locking every umbrella and asking borrowers to leave a cash deposit.
sentences.zh: 一名男子建議把每把傘都鎖起來，並要求借用者留下現金押金。

sentences.text: Another wanted to close the boxes until the dangerous weather passed.
sentences.zh: 另一個人則想關閉所有歸還箱，直到危險天氣過去。

sentences.text: Maya understood their fear, but she worried those rules would block people who needed help most during a public emergency.
sentences.zh: Maya 理解他們的恐懼，但她擔心那些規定會讓最需要幫助的人無法借到傘。

sentences.text: Ms. Lin asked the group to design a storm plan that kept both people and umbrellas safe before the first heavy rain began.
sentences.zh: 林女士請大家在第一場豪雨開始前，設計一套能同時保護人和雨傘的風暴計畫。

sentences.text: Noah made a list of volunteers who could check each return box without traveling far.
sentences.zh: Noah 列出一份志工名單，讓每個人不必走太遠就能檢查附近的歸還箱。

sentences.text: Mr. Chen brought a repair kit, strong tape, and two umbrellas from his apartment, and he offered to stay all night.
sentences.zh: 陳先生從公寓帶來修理工具、強力膠帶和兩把傘，還主動表示願意整夜留下來。

sentences.text: Maya posted a message through the library and cafe pages, asking residents to borrow only what they needed and return umbrellas indoors.
sentences.zh: Maya 透過圖書館和咖啡店的頁面發布訊息，請居民只借需要的數量，並把傘歸還到室內。

sentences.text: The team moved the bus station box behind a wall and tied its wooden cover down.
sentences.zh: 團隊把公車站的歸還箱移到牆後，並把木製遮蓋牢牢綁住。

sentences.text: They also placed towels and a repair table inside the cafe for wet or damaged umbrellas.
sentences.zh: 他們還在咖啡店裡放置毛巾和修理桌，供濕掉或損壞的雨傘使用。

sentences.text: Before midnight, hard rain struck the windows, and strong wind shook every street sign.
sentences.zh: 午夜前，大雨敲打著窗戶，強風搖動每一面街道標誌。

sentences.text: Commuters rushed from late buses, while volunteers guided them toward the nearest blue umbrellas.
sentences.zh: 通勤者匆忙走下晚班公車，志工則引導他們前往最近的藍傘放置處。

sentences.text: Soon all eighteen original blue umbrellas were in use, and the paper chart became impossible to follow.
sentences.zh: 很快地，原有的十八把藍傘全都被借走，紙本表格也變得難以追蹤。

sentences.text: Maya worried that the open system was failing exactly when the neighborhood depended on it.
sentences.zh: Maya 擔心，這套開放制度偏偏在社區最依賴它的時刻失靈了。

sentences.text: Then a woman arrived carrying three wet umbrellas, although she had borrowed only one.
sentences.zh: 這時，一名女子帶著三把濕傘抵達，儘管她原本只借了一把。

sentences.text: She had collected two that were blowing across the sidewalk and brought them to safety.
sentences.zh: 她撿起兩把在人行道上被風吹動的傘，並把它們帶到安全的地方。

sentences.text: Other residents came with old umbrellas from closets, cars, and office drawers.
sentences.zh: 其他居民也帶著從衣櫃、汽車和辦公室抽屜找出的舊傘前來。

sentences.text: Mr. Chen and Noah repaired bent frames while Ms. Lin served hot tea to waiting travelers.
sentences.zh: 陳先生和 Noah 修理彎曲的傘架，林女士則端熱茶給等待中的旅客。

sentences.text: When a bus was delayed, four strangers shared two large umbrellas and walked home together.
sentences.zh: 一班公車誤點時，四位陌生人共撐兩把大傘，一起走路回家。

sentences.text: The storm did not make people selfish; instead, it gave them a reason to help one another.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨沒有使人變得自私，反而給了大家互相幫助的理由。

sentences.text: By dawn, the cafe held twenty-five umbrellas, but one original blue umbrella was still missing.
sentences.zh: 到了黎明，咖啡店裡已有二十五把傘，但仍有一把最初的藍傘沒有回來。

sentences.text: Maya was tired and disappointed, although the plan had helped more people than she could count.
sentences.zh: Maya 又累又失望，儘管這項計畫幫助的人已多到她數不清。

sentences.text: As the rain became lighter, someone returned the missing original blue umbrella beside the door.
sentences.zh: 雨勢變小時，有人把那把不見的原始藍傘歸還到門邊。

sentences.text: Its broken handle had been replaced with a smooth wooden one, and a note hung from the ribbon.
sentences.zh: 它原本壞掉的握把已換成光滑的木製握把，絲帶上還掛著一張字條。

sentences.text: The note said, "It helped me last week, so I fixed it for the next person."
sentences.zh: 字條寫著：「它上週幫了我，所以我把它修好，留給下一個人。」

sentences.text: The team decided against locks and deposits, but they added safety warnings and regular repair nights.
sentences.zh: 團隊決定不使用鎖和押金，但增加了安全提醒與固定的夜間修傘活動。

sentences.text: Maya wrote the final storm count on the chart: no umbrellas missing, eight added, and a neighborhood connected.
sentences.zh: Maya 在表格上寫下風暴後的最終統計：沒有傘遺失、多了八把傘，以及一個連結起來的社區。

questions.q: Why did some neighbors want locks and cash deposits?
options: They feared umbrellas would be lost or damaged
They wanted to sell tickets to the cafe
They needed money for the library

questions.q: What happened after all eighteen umbrellas were borrowed?
options: The volunteers closed every return point
Residents returned found umbrellas and brought extra ones

questions.q: What did the team decide after the storm?
options: To stay open while adding safety warnings and repair nights
